items.title: Learning complex goals with iterated amplification
items.summary: We’re proposing an AI safety technique called iterated amplification that lets us specify complicated behaviors and goals that are beyond human scale, by demonstrating how to decompose a task into simpler sub-tasks, rather than by providing labeled data or a reward function. items.summaryZh: OpenAI提出了一种名为“迭代放大”（Iterated Amplification）的AI安全技术。该方法通过将复杂任务分解为简单子任务，而非依赖标注数据或奖励函数，旨在实现对人类尺度之外复杂行为的规范与控制，为AI安全研究提供了新的思路。

aiReview.reasonZh: 探讨了AI安全领域的重要技术路径，对理解复杂目标分解具有理论意义。
